verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents automatic setup of GPU vendor drivers, including NVIDIA, during installation, which covers part of the story. However, there is no evidence of a documented path for developers to build or install custom kernel modules for specialized/accelerated workloads. missing for 10: evidence of DKMS/kernel-module build tooling, developer workflow for compiling custom kernel modules, and any accelerated-workload-specific driver customization.
